_how: Every folder in partner-docs must be listed here. kind: client | partner | test. stage (clients): draft (not sendable, hidden from lookup), awaiting-signature (sent, unsigned), booked (signed, money still owed), paid (nothing owed), closed (lost or ghosted; no signing or payment). payment: stripe | installments | external | legacy. source: clickup means the page holds only design and copy and every client fact comes from the ClickUp agreement whose Portal Slug matches the folder. Moving a portal out of draft is the ready-to-send switch.
